batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2024-2025, Set-12 (সেটকোড: ১২) — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading from the Udvash Academic & Admission Care 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' question-bank book (JU A & D Units, 2015–2025), book PDF pages 93–96 (printed book pages 92–95), with the printed answer table on PDF p.96 and printed worked solutions for Q77–80 only on the same page. EXTRACTION STAGE ONLY: every question's content and answer are marked 'unverified' pending a later cross-source verification stage. Printed subject order and counts exactly as they appear in the book: Bangla Q1–4 (4), Botany Q5–26 (22), English Q27–30 (4), Zoology Q31–52 (22), Chemistry Q53–76 (24), General Mathematics Q77–80 (4). Botany/Zoology are recorded as canonical subject 'Biology' with the split preserved in topic; the printed সাধারণ গণিত block keeps the source subject label 'General Mathematics' (NOT renamed to Higher Mathematics). The printed answer table gives a single key letter for all 80 questions — no dashes and no dual keys — and the four printed worked solutions (Q77–80) agree with the table. The Q80 worked solution explicitly calls that question defective ('প্রশ্নটি ত্রুটিপূর্ণ') yet still keys (d); stem and key are preserved as printed. Other printed anomalies preserved as-is: Q21 stem's last word printed 'ফায়'; Q22 stem printed without a question mark; Q44 'সংক্রমন' and Q70 'ট্রাইট্রেশনের' printed spellings; a stray ')' glyph after Q10's (b) label. Bangla numerals in numeric options were converted to Western digits per project convention; chemical formulas and exponents were linearised (subscripts flattened, ^ for superscripts). These are publisher compilation keys, NOT official JU keys. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

The 2024-2025 D Unit Set-12 paper occupies PDF pages 93–96 (printed book pages 92–95): questions Q1–80, the printed answer table (উত্তরমালা) on PDF p.96, and printed worked solutions for Q77–80 only on PDF p.96. The next paper (D Unit 2024-2025 Set-13) begins on PDF p.97. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page (zoomed crops used for small type); mathematical notation linearised with ^ for superscripts and flattened subscripts. The sha256 recorded here is the hash computed from the workspace copy of this PDF (sources/pdfs/ju-ad-abswer-combined.pdf).
